usedFor: HubSpot holds tickets, deals and contacts, and Teamhood receives the work as items through “Create Item”.

bestTemplate.name: “Ticket Created or Updated” in HubSpot, then “Create Item” in Teamhood
bestTemplate.why: A support ticket becomes a board item, so the delivery team sees what customers raised.

watchOut: “Ticket Created or Updated” in HubSpot also fires on updates, so one ticket can create a second item.
